plugin.note: burst or barrage stacked Dust devils with a facemask or Slayer helmet. Catacombs is the normal recommendation; Smoke Dungeon has a task-only multicombat area without cannon use, and Wilderness Slayer Cave adds cannonable multicombat with PvP risk.

requirements: 65 Slayer to damage Dust devils and receive the task
Started Desert Treasure I to receive assignments and enter the Smoke Dungeon
Facemask, Slayer helmet, or Slayer helmet (i) required to avoid rapid damage and stat drain
Ancient Magicks access for burst and barrage methods
Bigger and Badder unlock for Choke devil superior spawns
mechanics: Dust devils attack with ranged melee: the attack is treated as melee, but accuracy rolls against the player's ranged defence.
Protect from Melee blocks their regular attacks.
Without face protection, Dust devils deal rapid damage and drain Attack, Strength, Ranged, Magic, Agility, Defence, and Prayer stats.
Regular Dust devils have very low Defence and a 35% air elemental weakness.
Catacombs Dust devils are level 110 with 130 Hitpoints and give 130 Slayer XP instead of the standard 105 XP.
Bursting and barraging work well because several Dust devil rooms are multicombat and Dust devils can be stacked by movement or luring.
Choke devils are superior monsters with 300 Hitpoints, a max hit of 24, no defensive bonuses, and a 25% air elemental weakness.

methods.label: Catacombs burst or barrage
methods.summary: Use Ancient Magicks in the Catacombs of Kourend for the default safe, high-XP Dust devil task.
recommendedFor: Players prioritising Slayer and Magic experience
Ancient shard and dark totem piece collection
requiredOrKeyItems: Virtus robes or other magic damage gear
steps: Travel to the south-east Catacombs Dust devil room with face protection equipped.
Tag nearby Dust devils, then run corners or around obstacles until they stack on one tile.
Cast Ice Burst, Smoke Burst, Ice Barrage, or another Ancient Magicks area spell on the stacked pile.
Keep Protect from Melee active when taking hits; their accuracy still checks ranged defence.
Use bracelet of slaughter if extending the task for experience is more valuable than a Tormented bracelet damage swap.
Loot high-value drops and Catacombs-only ancient shards or dark totem pieces when safe.
risks: Catacombs Dust devils have more Hitpoints and hit harder than the level 93 versions.
The Catacombs cannot use a dwarf multicannon.
inventory: Rune pouch with Ancient Magicks runes
Teleport to house or other one-click exit
notes: The task page recommends Catacombs unless the assignment is locked to Smoke Dungeon by Konar or assigned by Krystilia.
Drops usually cover supply costs when using efficient burst or barrage setups.

methods.label: Smoke Dungeon
methods.summary: Use the quieter Smoke Dungeon Dust devil areas when assigned there or when avoiding crowded Catacombs worlds.
recommendedFor: Players wanting quieter Dust devil rooms
Hard Desert Diary Dust devil kill
requiredOrKeyItems: Slayer helmet for Hard Desert Diary completion
Dwarf multicannon for single-way rooms only
steps: Enter the Smoke Dungeon after starting Desert Treasure I with face protection equipped.
For burst or barrage tasks, use the western task-only multicombat area guarded by Dusty Aliv.
Stack Dust devils in the task-only area and cast Ancient Magicks area spells.
Do not attempt to place a dwarf multicannon in the task-only western multicombat area.
If using cannon and melee or ranged instead, use the remaining Smoke Dungeon rooms, which are single-way combat and allow cannoning.
Wear a Slayer helmet for one kill here if completing the Hard Desert Diary.
risks: The Smoke Dungeon is more remote than the Catacombs.
Cannon and multicombat are split between different Smoke Dungeon Dust devil areas.
notes: This location has the highest Dust devil count on the task page, but the useful method depends on whether the player wants multicombat spells or cannon use.

methods.label: Wilderness Slayer Cave
methods.summary: Use Wilderness Slayer Cave Dust devils for Krystilia tasks or when accepting PvP risk for cannonable multicombat.
recommendedFor: Players willing to risk Wilderness deaths
requiredOrKeyItems: Royal seed pod or other escape teleport that works at the cave level
steps: Bring only gear and supplies you are willing to risk in level 25-28 Wilderness.
Enter the Wilderness Slayer Cave and move to the north-east Dust devil area.
Set up cannon if using a cannon strategy, or stack monsters for burst and barrage spells.
Use blighted ancient ice sacks to lower rune costs for Wilderness Ancient Magicks.
Stay ready to teleport or tank if player killers appear.
risks: player killers can attack in the Wilderness Slayer Cave.
Deaths can cost unprotected equipment, runes, cannonballs, and loot.
Teleport options are restricted by Wilderness level and teleblock.
notes: Dust devils here use the Wilderness Slayer Cave drop table.

methods.label: Luring and stacking
methods.summary: Use fast, low-commitment tagging or Dinh's bulwark special attacks to gather Dust devils before area spells.
steps: Use blowpipe, darts, knives, or Hunters' sunlight crossbow to tag Dust devils while moving.
Use Dinh's bulwark special attacks to draw aggression when available, ideally with Lightbearer for more frequent special energy.
Use goading potion to force aggression if choosing a potion-based luring approach.
Keep moving until the tagged Dust devils align and collapse onto a single tile.
Swap back to the Ancient Magicks weapon and cast burst or barrage once the pile is stacked.
Use Venator bow as a lower-effort ranged alternative where chaining hits is preferred over full Ancient Magicks bursting.
risks: Dinh's bulwark luring can consume run energy quickly.
Poor stacks reduce burst and barrage value.
notes: The task page lists Dinh's bulwark, blowpipe, darts, knives, Hunters' crossbows, goading potion, and Venator bow as effective luring or alternative tools.

methods.label: Choke devil
methods.summary: Handle Choke devil superior spawns with face protection and focused damage.
recommendedFor: Players with Bigger and Badder unlocked
Konar tasks where Brimstone keys are desired
requiredOrKeyItems: Strong magic, ranged, or melee weapon
Food if low Defence or low Hitpoints
steps: Keep face protection equipped; Choke devils use the same protection check as regular Dust devils.
Move away from the Dust devil pile if needed so the superior can be targeted cleanly.
Use Protect from Melee and continue attacking; Choke devils have high combat stats but no defensive bonuses.
Return to stacking regular Dust devils after the superior dies.
risks: Choke devils can hit up to 24.
Ignoring the superior while continuing to stack regular Dust devils can add unnecessary incoming damage.
notes: Choke devils require Bigger and Badder and give 3000 Slayer XP.
On Konar assignments, Choke devils guarantee a Brimstone key.

methods.label: Inventory and loot
methods.summary: Bring Ancient Magicks runes, prayer sustain, and loot-storage items so long burst trips remain profitable.
inventory: Rune pouch with water, blood, and death runes for Ancient Magicks
bracelet of slaughter swaps for extending the task
Teleport to house or another reliable exit
Optional Dinh's bulwark, blowpipe, darts, knives, Hunters' sunlight crossbow, or Venator bow for luring
steps: Prioritise magic damage gear such as Kodai wand, occult necklace, imbued god cape, Virtus or Ancestral robes, and damage-boosting off-hands where available.
Use bracelet of slaughter for extra Dust devil kills when chasing Magic and Slayer experience.
Carry herb sack and gem bag so frequent Dust devil drops do not shorten trips.
Keep a fast teleport available, especially if using Wilderness Slayer Cave.
notes: The task page notes that Tormented bracelet damage is often less useful than bracelet of slaughter because extending Dust devil tasks is valuable experience.
Kodai wand is especially effective because of its magic damage bonus, infinite water runes, and rune-saving effect.
